**L5/L6 dual-semantics hazard on governance.approvalActors (H0-LOCK3-DUAL)**

**What**: Verified in the tree that `governance.approvalActors` is read as `botAllowlist` by BOTH governance gates with OPPOSITE semantics. L5 `brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs` (evaluateActor:90-94, config read:223-232): actor in list => PASS (permissive — authorized to apply status:approved). L6 `brain/scripts/vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs` (evaluateBrainWritesReviewed:111, config read:165-174): human approver = `approvers.find(a => a !== author && !botAllowlist.includes(a))`, so actor in list => EXCLUDED from human-approver count (restrictive). One reviewer registration in that single key would simultaneously de-authorize it at L6 AND authorize it to self-apply status:approved at L5. Fix (issue #266 H0, finding H0-LOCK3-DUAL): split the key — L6 reads a NEW `governance.reviewActors`; reviewer is never in `governance.approvalActors`.
**Why**: Designing the invocable cold reviewer (Track H / #266). The reviewer must be structurally unable to become a merge authorizer.
**Where**: brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs, brain.config.json
**Learned**: (1) NEITHER key is populated in brain.config.json today — it has only `governance.ignoreList` (lines 15-28); both gates read approvalActors and default to []. So reviewActors is genuinely new and approvalActors must still be formalized. (2) Lock 1 confirmed: L6 counts only `state === 'APPROVED'` (line 99); COMMENTED ignored by construction. (3) `VERBS` (cli.mjs:22-27) has 16 verbs, none writing to review/comment/label surface. (4) vcs-contract.md:61 is stale — says "15 verbs" but VERBS has 16 (missing `capabilities` from its table); adding the 4 new H0 verbs must fix that prose too. Drift-guard is providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs (parameterized over both providers).
